items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: Because the GAR of the Nekudim, too, was not complete, for after the illumination of the coupling of AB-SAG of AK in the Nekudim ceased, the lower Hei and the restriction returned to the place of the sockets of the eyes, at which point they were not fit for coupling. Hence GAR, too, was compelled to rise up to the one above them, which is the head of SAG of AK. (Inner Light, page 601, Sub Header, “The Raising,” and Inner Observation, item 3)
